The '''bombardment of Shalam''' was committed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Ishin-Il-Raz]]<ref name="Who" /> between [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] and the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="Time" /> The attack, taking place on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Shalam]]<ref name="Who" /> in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]],<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Shalam system/Legends|Shalam system]]</ref> was part of Il-Raz's attempt to earn the approval of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], which included several other engagements such as the [[Massacre of Myomar]]. From the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] of his [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]], the ''[[Emperor's Disciple]]'', Il-Raz oversaw the bombardment,<ref name="Who" /> which was a victory for the Empire.<ref name="CSWE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The bombardment of Shalam was first mentioned in the article "[[Who's Who: Imperial Grand Admirals]]," written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Abel G. Peña]] and published in [[Star Wars Insider 66|''Star Wars Insider'' 66]]<ref name="Who" /> on [[March 4]], [[2003]].<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=community/news/2003/02/news20030203.html|text=''Star Wars Insider'' #66}}</ref>
